The '''Prime Sector''' was a [[Sector|subsector]] located in the [[Lothal sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Warhead Gallery" /> During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the Lothal sector—including the Prime Sector—was ruled by the Empire<ref name="UltimateSW" /> and [[Governor|governed]] by [[Arihnda Pryce]], a [[human]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="DB Pryce">{{Databank|governor-pryce|Governor Pryce}}</ref> from the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Prime Sector appeared in a holographic map created for the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Warhead (episode)|Warhead]]," featured in the Behind-the-Scenes Gallery for the episode on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Warhead Gallery" /> However, the map does not appear in the actual episode.<ref name="Warhead">{{Rebels|Warhead (episode)}}</ref> The map later appeared in the episode "[[Zero Hour]]."<ref name="Zero">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>
